description: Start a free redesign for a public Shopify storefront, even if the user has never connected it to Fudge. The public homepage must identify the store’s myshopify.com domain. Fudge reads the homepage and public products and returns a link to choose design references and generate three homepage concepts. The concepts are created on Fudge without editing or publishing to the live store.

domain.description: Public HTTPS domain of the Shopify storefront to redesign, e.g. example.com.

instructions.description: What the merchant wants from the redesign, in their words.

name: start_website_redesign
title: Start website redesign
